examined_formations.title: SMALL_AUTOMATED_CASHFLOWING_WEB_ASSET_ACQUISITION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 低价已有流量/收入自动交付网站资产 → 收购后直接承接现有价值流
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A5 currently lists the live Shaibar/Aether Tarot Python site for CNY 5,000, marks 500+ IP/day and income present, and describes per-use AI delivery. The live site exposes the same paid product tiers. A5 provides escrow and an asset handover workflow. However actual settled revenue, buyer conversion, maintenance burden, code/IP ownership and traffic provenance are not independently proven; the advertised USDT payment rail is unacceptable as the default operating assumption for a China operator without a compliant replacement.

attraction_brief.a_side: A verified individual seller is actively offering an operating digital asset for CNY 5,000 through an escrow marketplace.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: The current A5 listing is active, seller-authenticated and gives an explicit asking price plus transfer workflow.
attraction_brief.b_side: The live product exposes paid, automatically generated AI readings at fixed per-use prices, showing a callable consumption surface.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: The public Shaibar site is live and exposes CNY-priced paid reading products; A5 marks the asset as having income, but settled orders are not yet independently evidenced.
attraction_brief.operator: The operator would want to buy an already-running low-ticket asset only if domain/code/data/payment control and existing paid demand transfer together, replacing build-and-acquire-user work with ownership of a running flow.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must prove that routine fulfillment is automated and that ongoing traffic/revenue do not depend on the seller or operator continuously recruiting distributors, producing content, or manually serving buyers.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: A bounded acquisition could transfer an already-running inbound-to-payment-to-AI-delivery loop instead of asking the founder to manufacture demand from zero.

examined_formations.title: TRANSFERABLE_APP_STORE_MICRO_APP_ACQUISITION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 可官方转移的 App Store 小应用资产 → 接收后承接评分/用户/后续收入
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Apple officially supports app ownership transfer while preserving availability, ratings, reviews, bundle ID and user updates; post-transfer sales/payment data accrue to the recipient. Individual enrollment is available for USD 99/year. Current A5 China supply proves app/source assets exist, but the observed low-ticket 2026 examples have no current income, while cashflowing examples are much larger, operationally heavy, or rights/compliance-risky.

attraction_brief.a_side: Chinese sellers currently offer self-developed apps and app-backed digital businesses for transfer.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: A5 has current 2026 app/source listings including a CNY 25,000 self-developed AI English app with no current traffic/income.
attraction_brief.b_side: App Store users can continue downloading and paying after an official app transfer when transfer criteria are met.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: Apple states the app remains available, ratings/reviews persist and the recipient receives post-transfer sales/payment information.
attraction_brief.operator: A small operator would benefit from acquiring an already-monetizing low-maintenance app rather than rebuilding distribution.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must already have nonzero machine-verifiable proceeds and low support/content burden.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: Official ownership transfer can move an installed/reviewed app plus future platform proceeds to a new owner.

examined_formations.title: CASHFLOWING_CONTENT_SITE_MICRO_ACQUISITION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 已有流量/收入内容站 → 小额收购后继续变现
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A5 currently lists multiple CNY 30k-50k sites with meaningful traffic and income, but their own descriptions say content is manually updated or revenue requires publishing/soft-article operations. The purchased asset transfers traffic but not a founder-light machine delivery loop.

attraction_brief.a_side: Sellers list established traffic sites with income for explicit prices.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: Current A5 listings include a CNY 30,000 navigation site at 15k+ IP/day with income and a CNY 50,000 BIM education site with income.
attraction_brief.b_side: Advertisers/members already pay around existing traffic/content.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: Listings mark income present and describe advertising/member/soft-article monetization.
attraction_brief.operator: Operator would want an inherited traffic asset only if monetization persists without continuous publishing/sales labor.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Fails when seller description requires manual publishing, content updates, soft-article sales or recurring editorial work.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: Buying indexed traffic can shortcut audience acquisition.

examined_formations.title: TRANSFERABLE_WECHAT_MINIPROGRAM_OPERATING_ASSET
examined_formations.chinese_title: 在运营微信小程序资产 → 主体变更后承接用户与业务
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A5's current supply board lists an operating membership-management mini-program for transfer. Current 2026 operational guidance shows an official subject-change path, but the receiving subject must be an organization/business, payment merchant bindings must be changed, filing must be redone and manual approval steps remain. No current revenue or automated fulfillment evidence is shown for the observed listing.

attraction_brief.a_side: A current seller explicitly offers an operating mini-program for transfer.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: A5 current supply board lists an operating membership-management mini-program transfer.
attraction_brief.b_side: A transferred mini-program can preserve an established user-facing entry if platform subject-change requirements are satisfied.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: Current platform-operational guidance documents subject change and continuity mechanics.
attraction_brief.operator: Operator would want a transferable mini-program only if users, payment and automated service survive transfer with low activation friction.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must not require ongoing merchant-service operations or repeated manual service delivery.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: An existing WeChat entry could transfer rather than restarting from zero.

excluded_observations: Pure source-code packs without existing traffic or revenue were excluded as build inventory rather than running value flows.
Copyright-sensitive scraped-content/video assets were excluded from retention even when traffic was visible.
Domain speculation was excluded because marketplace-native settlement and transfer do not create recurring customer payment or product delivery.
USDT acceptance was not counted as a compliant native payment gate for a China operator.
